rules.action: The validator client refuses to start when an enabled validator has no suggested_fee_recipient in validator_definitions.yml and this flag is unset. Set one of them.
Beacon nodes append the client version to graffiti unless you pass --graffiti-append false, the graffiti is already 30-32 bytes, or the beacon node uses --private.

The validator client calls proposer duties v2 by default. Add --disable-proposer-duties-v2 if the beacon node does not support it, including a Nimbus beacon node, or if you see 'Failed to download proposer duties'.
